name: Reservas internacionais, incluindo ouro
note: Estoque de reservas internacionais no fim do ano, incluindo ouro monetário, direitos especiais de saque, posição no FMI e ativos em moeda estrangeira sob controle das autoridades monetárias. Não são dólares em caixa do Tesouro Nacional; não medir como receita anual. Ouro avaliado a preços de mercado.
source: Banco Mundial · International Financial Statistics database, International Monetary Fund (IMF)
sourceNote: Reserve assets are external assets, including monetary gold, that are readily available to and controlled by monetary authorities for meeting balance of payments financing needs, for intervention in exchange markets to affect the currency exchange rate, and for other related purposes (such as maintaining confidence in the currency and the economy, and serving as a basis for foreign borrowing). Reserve assets must be denominated and settled in foreign currency. This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.

name: Pessoas que usam a internet
note: Pessoas que usaram a internet nos últimos três meses, em qualquer lugar/dispositivo. UIT/Banco Mundial. Mede uso, não velocidade, qualidade da conexão ou competências digitais; um indicador de difusão tecnológica, não de produção científica.
source: Banco Mundial · World Telecommunication/ICT Indicators Database, International Telecommunication Union (ITU), uri: https://datahub.itu.int/
sourceNote: Internet users are individuals who have used the Internet (from any location) in the last 3 months. The Internet can be used via a computer, mobile phone, personal digital assistant, games machine, digital TV etc.

name: Pedidos de patente por residentes
note: Pedidos de patente de residentes à autoridade nacional/regional, segundo OMPI/Banco Mundial. Não são patentes concedidas, nem pedidos mundiais de brasileiros; pedidos não medem qualidade, impacto comercial ou produtividade da pesquisa.
source: Banco Mundial · WIPO Patent Report: Statistics on Worldwide Patent Activity, World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), note: The International Bureau of WIPO assumes no responsibility with respect to the transformation of these data.
sourceNote: Patent applications are worldwide patent applications filed through the Patent Cooperation Treaty procedure or with a national patent office for exclusive rights for an invention--a product or process that provides a new way of doing something or offers a new technical solution to a problem. A patent provides protection for the invention to the owner of the patent for a limited period, generally 20 years.

name: Agropecuária — valor adicionado
note: Valor adicionado da agricultura, silvicultura e pesca dividido pelo PIB. Não é a participação de todo o agronegócio; insumos e processamento aparecem em outros setores. Estrutura econômica, sem direção normativa.
sourceNote: Agriculture, forestry, and fishing corresponds to ISIC (Rev. 4) divisions 01-03 and includes the exploitation of vegetal and animal natural resources, comprising the activities of growing of crops, raising and breeding of animals, harvesting of timber and other plants, animals or animal products from a farm or their natural habitats.Value added is the contribution to the economy by a producer or an industry or an institutional sector, which is estimated by the total value of output produced and deducting the total value of intermediate consumption of goods and services used to produce that output. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period. Note: For VAB countries, gross value added at factor cost is used as the denominator.

name: Indústria e construção — valor adicionado
note: Valor adicionado da indústria, incluindo construção, transformação, extração e utilidades, dividido pelo PIB. Não equivale apenas à indústria de transformação. Estrutura econômica, sem direção normativa.
sourceNote: Industry (including construction) corresponds to ISIC (Rev.4) divisions 05-43. It is comprised of mining, manufacturing, construction, electricity, water, and gas industries. Value added is the contribution to the economy by a producer or an industry or an institutional sector, which is estimated by the total value of output produced and deducting the total value of intermediate consumption of goods and services used to produce that output. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.

name: Serviços — valor adicionado
note: Valor adicionado de serviços dividido pelo PIB, incluindo comércio, finanças, transportes e serviços públicos. As parcelas de valor adicionado não somam necessariamente 100% do PIB por impostos líquidos sobre produtos e diferenças de cálculo.
sourceNote: Services industries correspond to ISIC (Rev. 4) divisions 45-99 and includes wholesale and retail trade, repair of motor vehicles, hotels and restaurants, transport, storage and communication, financial intermediation, real estate, renting and business activities, public administration and defence, compulsory social security, education, health and social work, other community, social and personal service activities, private households with employed persons, and extra-territorial organizations and bodies. Value added is the contribution to the economy by a producer or an industry or an institutional sector, which is estimated by the total value of output produced and deducting the total value of intermediate consumption of goods and services used to produce that output. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.

name: Exportações de mercadorias — FOB
note: Exportações/importações anuais de mercadorias, valor FOB em US$ correntes. Exclui serviços e não equivale à exportação das contas nacionais. Tabelas MDIC de 1997 a 2025, revisadas até a consulta; anos anteriores permanecem sem valor. A conversão de US$ milhões do arquivo para US$ usa multiplicação por 1.000.000. Não se interpreta variação nominal em dólar como variação de volume.
